params.name: details
params.description: true to return inventory summaries with additional summarized inventory details and quantities. Otherwise, returns inventory summaries only (default value).

params.name: granularityType
params.description: The granularity type for the inventory aggregation level.

params.name: granularityId
params.description: The granularity ID for the inventory aggregation level.

params.name: startDateTime
params.description: A start date and time in ISO8601 format. If specified, all inventory summaries that have changed since then are returned. You must specify a date and time that is no earlier than 18 months prior to the date and time when you call the API. Note: Changes in inboundWorkingQuantity, inboundShippedQuantity and inboundReceivingQuantity are not detected.

params.name: sellerSkus
params.description: A list of seller SKUs for which to return inventory summaries. You may specify up to 50 SKUs.

params.name: sellerSku
params.description: A single seller SKU used for querying the specified seller SKU inventory summaries.

params.name: nextToken
params.description: String token returned in the response of your previous request. The string token will expire 30 seconds after being created.

params.name: marketplaceIds
params.description: The marketplace ID for the marketplace for which to return inventory summaries.

items.docs:
Returns a list of inventory summaries. The summaries returned depend on the presence or absence of the startDateTime, sellerSkus and sellerSku parameters:

- All inventory summaries with available details are returned when the startDateTime, sellerSkus and sellerSku parameters are omitted.
